teaser: The SGit Newsroom becomes an official publication: a publisher and editor, standards, corrections, a withdrawal process, complaints, and a regulator next.
core_idea: In the UK no licence makes a journalist; a publication becomes accountable by saying who publishes it and who answers for it, publishing and keeping standards, correcting in the open, withdrawing only with a notice, taking complaints, and submitting to an independent regulator. The SGit Newsroom now has the imprint, standards, corrections log, withdrawal process and complaints route, says plainly that agents write under the editor's responsibility, and is applying to IMPRESS and for an ISSN.

nodes.label: Why now
nodes.summary: A story read through secondary reports, a quote misattributed, corrected, then withdrawn.

nodes.label: What makes a publication official
nodes.summary: No licence; an imprint, standards, corrections, withdrawals, complaints and a regulator.

nodes.label: The right of reply
